selection.rationale: Interval 01:H1 selects only non-replay, non-slowmo footage events (Shot, two Substitutions, Free_kick) spanning the large source jump between the opponent opening goal and the equalizer. This is the most compact trial that could reveal whether the 2428.9s source gap hides a meaningful rhythm-reset sub-story (shot miss followed by substitutions then a free kick) that would justify an insert. All other proposals either include known replay/slowmo events (interval_02:H4, interval_02:H5) or are less directly tied to the diagnosed transition gap. The trial requests video observation only and does not authorize an edit.
